_note: Hand-written colour for the weekly email — one or two sentences per code, appended by the desk, shown under that deal's table. make_weekly_email.py never invents commentary; a code missing here just gets its numbers. Keep lines factual and sourced.

0625.colour: Wires ran 'plunges 10%' and 'ends flat' on the same day and both were true: it traded to 43.72 in the first minutes and was walked back to close one tick under issue, all inside a live Goldman mandate. Watch whether the bid persists into the shoe deadline.

9615.colour: A 3,835x retail book and it still broke issue — priced at the cap, 62% of the offer locked in cornerstones, so the free float is tiny and the tape is thin. Local press flagged the break the same evening.

3223.colour: Priced at 100.00 under the 102.80 cap on a 927x book, then the debut printed open = close = offer to the cent, low 97.10 — a stabiliser pinning the issue price, not a market finding it. Still worth respecting until the shoe dies.

_grey_market: Grey market (暗盤) = the broker-run evening session the night before listing, 16:15-18:30. Measured across the 122 deals now on file it called the day-1 DIRECTION right 89% of the time (108/122): where the grey close was negative, 30 of 39 also closed down on debut, median -13.7%. It is the best single read on a debut that exists, and it is capture-or-lose — no public archive of past sessions exists, so the weekly run is what builds the history.
